claims.evidence: The 36 design-table names plus .d match exactly the 36 raw.zip top-level .d directories; mqpar.xml lists the same 36 files.

claims.location: source and factor values, all rows
claims.value: 3 replicate preparations in each of 12 groups
claims.evidence: Depositor grouping gives untreated, treated, recovery crossed with OGG1 inhibitor and 4H8 antibody-conjugated beads or non-antibody-conjugated control beads, three samples each. The paper says proteomic samples were prepared in parallel from cell seeding in triplicate. PRIDE gives 1 mM H2O2 for 15 min and two-hour recovery; paper Methods gives TH5487 OGG1i at 10 µM. The publication Methods explicitly state non-antibody-conjugated beads were the negative control for MS.

claims.location: characteristics[cell line] and [cellosaurus accession], all rows
claims.evidence: PRIDE and paper name the parental Flp-In T-REx HEK293 line, Cellosaurus CVCL_U427. HEK293 is used for the supported cell-line ontology parent; exact derivative is retained as Cellosaurus name/accession.
Paper Methods and Cellosaurus identify female origin of the cell line.
Run-specific HyStarMetadata.xml Product Name is timsTOF Pro 2, agreeing with PRIDE structured instrument; publication narrative uses the less specific timsTOF pro wording.
PRIDE and paper Methods describe trypsin digestion. mqpar.xml gives Trypsin/P search specificity; the SDRF describes the physical reagent as Trypsin.

claims.location: acquisition, label, tolerances and modifications, all rows
claims.value: DDA PASEF, label-free, 10 ppm precursor, 40 ppm TOF fragment; C carbamidomethyl fixed, M oxidation and protein N-terminal acetyl variable
claims.evidence: Raw names include DDA, paper says PASEF, MaxQuant file map matches all 36, MaxQuant settings provide modification and analyzer-specific tolerance values.

claims.location: characteristics[immunoprecipitation capture] and factor value[immunoprecipitation capture], all rows
claims.value: 4H8 antibody-conjugated beads for baitIP; non-antibody-conjugated beads for IgPIP control
claims.evidence: Depositor design distinguishes baitIP and IgPIP runs; publication mass spectrometry Methods identifies 4H8-conjugated beads and non-antibody-conjugated beads as the control. The depositor IgPIP code alone does not establish an IgG antibody.

limitations: PRIDE data-processing prose incorrectly names swine/bovine databases; deposited mqpar.xml uses human FASTA paths and paper Methods says human UniProt.
The paper uses the generic name timsTOF pro; run metadata and PRIDE structured instrument identify Pro 2.
Exact tissue origin of HEK293 is not asserted as the sampled organism part.
Archive members are .d acquisitions inside raw.zip, so the SDRF names the acquisition directories rather than the outer ZIP.
The deposited group label IgPIP is retained in the run inventory; it is not interpreted as IgG because publication Methods describes antibody-free control beads.
